title: Tenet quest root manifest
description: The quest root's index.json, under config/tenet/quests/. Lists the top level of the quest book, in order. Absent means the tree is ordered the old way: group folders by name, which is how every pack written before this file existed still loads. Each entry names exactly one of a group, a chapter that belongs to no group, or a version-1 file.

settings.description: The tree's own defaults, as opposed to any chapter's: how rewards are handed over unless a reward says otherwise, how long after joining the first task check waits, and what the book calls itself. A missing block, or a missing key in one, means the default written here.

defaultAutoClaim.description: What a reward with `auto: "default"` does. Disabled means a finished quest waits to be collected, which is what a claim button is for.

defaultTeamReward.description: Whether a reward with no `team` of its own is a one-claim-for-the-team reward. False means every player collects their own copy.

suppressAllAutoclaiming.description: Holds every automatic payout, whatever individual rewards say. An operator's switch for an event, stored in the tree rather than in a save.

detectionDelay.description: Ticks after a player joins before their first task evaluation, so a login does not run every check in the book on one tick.

bookTitle.description: What the book calls itself, drawn top-left in its header. Empty or absent means the client's own title. Every client is told this when it syncs, so the name is the pack's rather than each player's.

bookIcon.description: What the book wears in its header: an item id as a bare string (every file written before the union), or an item, texture or entity object. Resolved on the client; an id it cannot resolve is drawn as the header's missing-item mark rather than refusing the pack.

fallbackLocale.description: The locale the tree's own strings are written in, e.g. "en_us". It is what a player reads when `lang/<locale>.json` has nothing for their language, and it sits underneath whichever locale they are served, so a pack can keep the strings every language shares in this one file and only the differences elsewhere. A locale the pack ships no file for still gets this one; the two are looked up together.

clickCommandLevel.description: What a canvas click's run_command runs as: 0 is the pressing player's own level, 2 is elevated enough for say, give and summon without opening op. Never above 2, and never the presser's own level however high that is.

group.description: A folder with a group.json in it.

chapter.description: A folder with a chapter.json in it, belonging to no group.

file.description: A version-1 flat file at the root.

itemRef.description: An item, a count, and optional data components. Not an ItemStack - resolved at the moment it is used.

components.description: 1.21 data components, keyed by component id in the datapack's own spelling.

icon.description: What the book wears in its header: an item, a texture file, or an entity drawn as its spawn egg. A bare string is also accepted, for an item id written before the union.

texture.description: A texture file by its own path, e.g. my_pack:textures/gui/emblem.png.

name.description: A single name in the quest folder, resolved against the quest root: a group or chapter folder's name, or a flat one-file questline's full file name. No separator, not `.` or `..`, and not beginning with `_`.
